sources.note: 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for three Trustees chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; the village has no website and no official source located publishes its current officers, so the post is created without memberships
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for a Clerk chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for a Treasurer chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for a Collector of Taxes chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; section 305 makes the Collector ex officio Chief of Police. No holder is published in any official source located
24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for an Auditor chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located

24 App. V.S.A. ch. 249 (Village of Newfane): section 201 provides for a Fire Marshal chosen by ballot at the annual meeting; no holder is published in any official source located. The post is flagged with the standing fire-officers scope question on issue #163
